name: Mobile Device Acquisition
description: Ability to perform forensic acquisition of mobile devices (iOS and Android). Covers logical acquisition, full filesystem extraction (including exploit-based methods such as checkm8 on A5–A11 iOS devices), physical acquisition, chip-off techniques, and JTAG/ISP extraction methods, and the limits that file-based encryption places on physical and chip-off methods. Includes handling device lock bypass, Faraday isolation, and maintaining chain of custody for mobile evidence.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to mobile device forensic acquisition

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands mobile acquisition types and the challenges unique to mobile forensics
evidence: Can describe the difference between logical, filesystem, and physical mobile acquisition
Understands why mobile devices require Faraday isolation during seizure
Can explain the challenges of device lock bypass and encryption on modern devices (e.g. BFU vs. AFU state, file-based encryption)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs logical and filesystem acquisitions of standard mobile devices under supervision
evidence: Performed logical (backup-based) and full filesystem acquisitions of iOS devices using tools such as Cellebrite UFED, GrayKey, or Magnet AXIOM under guidance
Performed logical and filesystem acquisitions of Android devices under guidance
Properly isolated devices in Faraday bags and documented device state at seizure
Recorded device identifiers (IMEI, serial number) and acquisition hashes with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently acquires mobile devices using appropriate methods based on device type, OS version, and lock state
evidence: Independently acquired 10+ mobile devices across iOS and Android platforms
Selected appropriate acquisition method based on device model, OS version, and lock status
Handled locked and encrypted devices using approved bypass techniques
Acquisition documentation consistently passes QA review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles advanced acquisition including chip-off, JTAG/ISP, and damaged devices; mentors junior examiners
evidence: Performed chip-off extraction from devices where software-based acquisition was not possible, accounting for storage encryption limits on modern devices
Executed JTAG or ISP acquisition methods for supported devices
Handled acquisition of damaged, water-damaged, or partially functional devices
Reviews acquisition procedures and mentors junior staff on mobile evidence collection

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines mobile acquisition methodology; validates tools against new device models; provides expert testimony on mobile evidence integrity
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's mobile forensic acquisition methodology
Validated acquisition tools and techniques for new device models and OS versions
Provided expert testimony on mobile evidence acquisition integrity
Trains teams on mobile acquisition techniques and tool evaluation

assessment_methods.description: Acquire data from iOS and Android test devices using appropriate methods, document the process, and verify acquisition integrity
Observe mobile device seizure and acquisition during a live or simulated investigation
